verdict: Ads are working; leads are not converting once they enter your system.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta campaign delivered 162 leads at $12.84 per lead, and that cost per lead improved another 1.46% this week as spend rose — the advertising itself is running well. The problem is what happens after a lead arrives: 136 contacts entered your CRM this period and zero were converted to opportunities or appointments, meaning leads are coming in and stalling before anyone works them. Automated follow-up sequences that were planned to activate lead intake have not yet gone live, leaving every new lead without a timed response. We're treating the intake process as the immediate priority, and the follow-up automation is targeted to be live by end of October.
